summary: While chanting, caster and carried equipment are unaffected by hostile actions from within 20'; may not approach enemy bases, touch objectives or impede play.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Covers the caster; their carried equipment is encoded separately (e6).

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: May not come within 20' of an unfriendly base; must immediately move to avoid it.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: May not interact with game items or game objectives.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: May not impede the play of other people in any manner; must immediately move to avoid such situations.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: After voluntarily carrying or touching a weapon (other than blocking) during Sanctuary, the caster may only voluntarily end it at base and must keep chanting until there.

effects.subject: bearer-equipment
effects.note: The caster's carried equipment is also unaffected.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: The caster may move about while in Sanctuary, subject to the limits in L1.

restrictions.note: May not impede the play of other people in any manner; must immediately move to avoid such situations.
Only after voluntarily carrying or touching a weapon (other than blocking): may then only end Sanctuary at base, chanting until there.

termination.note: Cease chanting and declare "No longer in sanctuary", audible to 20 feet. Only at base after touching a weapon (L2).
If the caster voluntarily carried or touched a weapon (other than blocking), they may only voluntarily end Sanctuary at base and must continue chanting until there.

properties.note: "No longer in sanctuary", audible out to 20 feet.

clarifications.text: The exit declaration must be audible out to 20 feet.

open_questions: 'Hostile actions originating from within 20'' is undefined (abilities and attacks alike, presumably).
